question: What is truly said to have been born of Cyavana and to have fallen into the great ocean?
premises: Something born of Cyavana is in view.
It is said to have fallen.
Its location is the great ocean.
inference: That which was born of Cyavana truly fell into the great ocean.
uncertainties: The identity of that which fell is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: Truly, that born of Cyavana fell into the great ocean.
